verdict.rationale: Linear's Customer Requests feature attaches customer requests to the issues and projects customers asked for. Issues can be filtered by customer, customers can be created manually, and Slack Asks from a shared channel can be automatically associated with a specific customer. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the manual step to attach an individual request to a customer, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link individual feedback items to the specific customers who submitted them

citations.quote: Understand customer use-cases directly on the issues and projects they’ve asked for
To automatically associate Asks from a shared Slack channel with a customer, open the customer page and choose **Link to Slack channel** from the **…** menu.
View and filter issues or projects by customer name, count, status, tier revenue, and size to identify high impact customer work
If your organization does not use these integrations, you can create Customers manually instead.
